turns.assessment: svc328's outer lightpaths remain healthy, but its middle lightpath och173 loses receive power at S15 while the opposite-direction receiver at S04 remains normal. The synchronized LOS and power loss on many other channels favors a hard shared optical-path interruption upstream of trx.och173.z, rather than a client-port or receiver-local failure. The supplied observations do not localize that interruption sufficiently to distinguish a fibre cut, pulled OMS input, amplifier pump failure, or WSS input-port failure, so no repair target reaches 80% confidence.

proposals.rationale: A hard span break would cause the abrupt receive-power loss and OCH_LOS at S15, and can account for simultaneous loss of multiple optical channels sharing the physical route.

Failure of the S04 transmitter for och173 would explain its loss at S15, but the many simultaneous channel failures strongly favor a shared optical component instead.
